site.tagline: Easy-language drafts of Swiss official texts. Apertus writes, code checks, you decide.
check.intro: The checker's rules on a text you wrote: sentence length, grammar, words, numbers, dates, Swiss spelling. In milliseconds, without a model, and nothing is stored. Facts and meaning need the full pipeline under New draft.
check.placeholder: Paste the easy-language text you want to check, headings and all.
check.private: Checked on this server only; no model call, nothing stored.
check.rules_hint: The {count} rules of the checker (docs/rules.md), in the document's language and for the chosen level.
check.summary: {blocks} blocks, {sentences} sentences, {words} words per sentence, readability {readability}
check.error.lang: No checker rules for {lang} yet; German and French texts are checked.
site.footer: A drafting assistant for professionals: every draft needs a human review, and a review by readers from the target group before publication.
drafts.how.title: How it works
drafts.how.read: Apertus reads the text and writes the draft
drafts.how.check: Code checks {count} rules and every value
drafts.how.judge: A second model judges, flagged blocks are repaired
drafts.how.review: You review every block and export
drafts.empty.title: No drafts yet
drafts.empty.text: Paste an official text, give a web address or upload a PDF. Or start with an example letter:
drafts.no_match: No drafts match. Clear the search or pick another status.
new.private_note: Only public pages are fetched; addresses in private networks are refused.
new.level.A2.desc: Easy language: short sentences, one statement each, hard words explained.
new.level.B1.desc: Plain language for readers with some reading practice.
new.condition.P2.title: P2 full
new.condition.P2.desc: Fact sheet, draft, rule check, judge, repair
new.condition.P1.title: P1 no judge
new.condition.P0.title: P0 baseline
new.addressee.placeholder: The person the letter speaks to, for example Lea Muster
new.notice.hint: The authority's fixed text: the first and the last paragraph of the export, word for word. Empty: the default for the document's language.
index.text.label: Pasted text
index.text.placeholder: Paste the official text here, headings and all.
index.url.label: Address of a public web page
index.url.hint: The page's main text is extracted; navigation and footers are dropped.
index.file.label: PDF with a text layer, HTML or plain text, up to 15 MB
index.title_field.placeholder: Shown in the list of drafts
index.models.hint: Leave empty for the configured models. Any model name the endpoint lists works.
condition.P0-ZH-complete: Baseline: the Canton of Zurich's prompt, keep everything
condition.P0-ZH-condensed: Baseline: the Canton of Zurich's prompt, essentials only
condition.P1: Fact sheet, draft and rule check
condition.P2: Full pipeline with judge and repair
step.baseline.title: Rewrite
step.baseline.desc: Apertus rewrites the text with one prompt
step.understand.title: Read
step.understand.desc: Apertus reads the document and writes the fact sheet
step.write.title: Write
step.check.title: Check
step.check.desc: Code checks the rules and every fact value
step.judge.title: Judge
step.judge.desc: A second Apertus model checks meaning and facts
step.repair.title: Repair
step.repair.desc: Apertus rewrites only the flagged blocks
step.review.title: Review

detail.omissions.one: , {n} thing left out with a reason
detail.omissions.other: , {n} things left out with a reason
detail.facts_rounds.one: , then {n} round for the missing facts alone
detail.facts_rounds.other: , then {n} rounds for the missing facts alone
detail.polish_rounds.one: , then {n} polish round for the language rules
detail.polish_rounds.other: , then {n} polish rounds for the language rules
stop.no_progress: a repair round brought no progress
stop.facts_round_failed: a round for the missing facts failed
stop.facts_no_progress: a round for the missing facts brought no progress
stop.max_facts_rounds.one: stopped after {n} round for the missing facts
stop.max_facts_rounds.other: stopped after {n} rounds for the missing facts
progress.failed_hint: The stages that finished are kept. Run the job again from where it stopped, or from the start.
progress.background.one: {n} passage marked as background that may be left out.
progress.background.other: {n} passages marked as background that may be left out.
progress.findings: {errors} errors and {warns} warnings in this version; marked blocks have findings.
progress.results_hint: Shown as each stage finishes. The review opens by itself when the pipeline is done.
progress.doc_findings: Findings about the whole document, such as missing facts, are not marked on a block.
review.title: Review: {title}
review.reader.hint: The text as a reader gets it, with your decisions: rejected blocks left out, edits in place.
review.code_splits.one: {n} word split by code with a Mediopunkt in this version.
review.code_splits.other: {n} words split by code with a Mediopunkt in this version.
review.code_splits_title: Long compound nouns get their Mediopunkt from code, not from the model; the rule check sees the split text.
review.notice: Fixed notice, the first and last paragraph of the export:
review.facts_hint: Code checks every value exactly. The judge checks the meaning. Click a fact to see its source and the blocks that carry it. For a missing fact, red marks the blocks where it belongs. Amber: code finds the value, the judge doubts the statement; read the blocks that carry it.
review.glossary_vocabulary_title: Added by code: the checked explanation of the vocabulary, not the model's.
review.glossary_review_hint: Explanations of hard words. They go into the export: decide them like the blocks.
review.findings_hint: Findings about the whole document. Findings on single blocks show in the draft.
review.no_doc_findings: No findings about the whole document.
review.core_hint: The five core questions, answered from the fact sheet.
review.no_facts: This draft has no fact sheet.
reader.print_hint: Prints the reader view on A4, unsaved decisions included. For a PDF, choose "Save as PDF" as the printer.
reader.md.desc: Plain text with headings, one sentence per line. For a content management system.
reader.html.desc: A web page in the reader layout, ready to print or to publish.
reader.json.desc: Source, fact sheet, every draft version, the findings and your decisions.
reader.decided_hint: Undecided blocks stay in, as drafted.
reader.complete_hint: Mark it complete in the review once every block is decided.
error.no_host: The URL has no host name.
error.private_url: The URL points into a private network ({host}); only public pages are fetched.
error.unknown_lang: Unknown language '{lang}'; use de, fr or it.
error.one_source: Give exactly one of: pasted text, a URL or a file.
error.text_too_long: The text is longer than {max:,} characters.
error.url_scheme: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.file_too_large: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
error.unknown_level: Unknown level '{level}'; use A2 or B1.
error.unknown_condition: Unknown condition '{condition}'; use P0, P1 or P2.
error.no_text: No text was found in the document.
error.unsupported_lang: The document is in {lang}. This version writes {langs}.
error.unknown_mode: Unknown mode '{mode}'; use standard or decision.
error.queue_full.one: The queue is full: {n} draft is waiting. Try again in a few minutes.
error.queue_full.other: The queue is full: {n} drafts are waiting. Try again in a few minutes.
error.busy: The server is reading other documents right now. Try again in a moment.
js.endpoint.unlisted: Endpoint {url}: reachable, model not in the endpoint's list.
js.endpoint.unreachable: Endpoint {url} not reachable ({error}). Check LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_API_KEY.
js.conflict: Not saved: someone else saved this review in the meantime. Reload the page to see their decisions.
js.no_answer: Not saved: the server did not answer.
js.reader_unsaved: Includes decisions that are not saved yet. The export uses the last saved review.
js.reader_failed: The reader view could not be loaded.
js.lang_auto: The language is detected when the draft is created
js.confirm_delete: Delete this draft and everything it produced? This cannot be undone.
js.saved_only: Exports use the last saved review. Decisions you have not saved are left out.
js.recover_asking: Asking Apertus for a sentence from the source paragraph...
js.recover_title: Suggestion from Apertus, from the source paragraph only
js.recover_resolved: Code finds the fact's value with this sentence. Code does not check the meaning: compare it with the source sentence.
js.recover_unresolved: Code still does not find the fact's value with this sentence.
js.recover_no_value: This fact has no value code can check. Compare the sentence with the source sentence.
js.recover_added: Added to block {block} as an edit. Read it and save the review.
js.recover_rejected.no_source: No suggestion: the fact has no source sentence.
js.recover_rejected.no_answer: No suggestion: Apertus gave no usable sentence in two tries.
js.recover_rejected.foreign: No suggestion: the sentence had values the source paragraph does not have ({values}).
js.recover_rejected.nothing_new: No suggestion: every sentence repeated the draft.
